issues.legal_issue: A censused slum may be redeveloped under Regulation 33(10) of the Development Control Regulations without a separate notification declaring it a slum under the Slum Act.

A slum rehabilitation project on land owned by MHADA may proceed under Regulation 33(10) rather than Regulation 33(5) where the land is not a MHADA layout and MHADA has granted a no-objection certificate.
Occupants must vacate premises for an approved slum rehabilitation project when eviction notices have been upheld by the grievance redressal authority and its order has attained finality.
